interpretation: Lower error area and negative differences favor the named policy.
interval_scope: Descriptive query-intervention bootstrap conditional on source data, fixed split, acquisition seeds, and fixed assessment/control bank. Excludes biological, guide/batch and common scoring-control uncertainty.
limitations: Intervals are ideal Gaussian diagnostics; post-selection coverage is unvalidated.
Scalar variances omit gene heteroskedasticity, guide/batch effects and source-coordinate uncertainty.
Unregularized ideal variances do not account for ridge shrinkage bias.
The discrepancy objective uses fixed-kernel variance as a surrogate for the ridge predictor's residual risk.
Seeds and cells are not independent biological replicates.
Local residual baseline is an adaptation, not a PerturbMap reproduction.
Optional PerturbMap reconstruction uses one source and paid validation/controls; implementation differences are declared in the comparator protocol.
Fixed-grid settings are declared in configuration; any development selection must be recorded separately.
